MIXED.interpretation: Do not correct pairs containing both UP and DOWN horses in V1.

interpretation: Preserving dissent direction materially improved the design over absolute-gap local correction.
The combined directional model beats MARKET_RAW on race log loss in both unseen folds, but the margin is small and route effects are not yet fully stable.
UP_ONLY is directionally useful in both folds, with a clear gain in 2024 and near-flat gain in 2025.
DOWN_ONLY is unstable across folds: worse in 2024 and materially better in 2025.
MIXED correctly self-disables in both folds via alpha=0.
Do not promote to production yet; next validation should test whether the directional gain survives stricter cross-year/segment stability checks before moving to value/ROI.
next: L2_DIRECTIONAL_STABILITY_V1: keep thresholds and routes frozen; run predeclared stability checks by year/race-class/market-price bands and bootstrap uncertainty. No new route or threshold search. If stable enough, freeze directional probability layer and move to L2B price/value evaluation.
